svg.title: Shreyas Singh — independently orbiting particle artwork
svg.desc: Shreyas Singh — developer, builder and student. The reference's planet crescent, crossing dust ribbons, mountain folds and small sun, with grain travelling around the planet and wind following the hills. Featured projects: JanSamadhan, NyayaAI, ARTERY and Adaptive Cache Simulator. Activity uses actual GitHub contributions. Project and contact links follow the artwork.
